name: ¿Quién Caerá?
summary: A thrilling game show where contestants battle for a grand cash prize, testing their general knowledge and luck with vibrant host Adamari López. Participants from across the U.S. Hispanic community must skillfully answer diverse questions to win big and avoid the dreaded trapdoor – a single wrong answer means elimination!

name: ¿Quién Caerá? KIDS
summary: ¿Quién Caerá? KIDS brings a super-sized dose of fun and smarts, delivering the same thrilling excitement as ¿Quién Caerá?, but this time with brilliant kids taking center stage in the competition. Hosted by Adamari López and co-hosted by her daughter Alaïa Costa-López, this special edition sees talented Hispanic kids from various nationalities test their general knowledge by answering diverse questions under Adamari's lively guidance. Each round reveals who will triumph and who will take the plunge.

name: You Can't Take It with You
summary: The show takes place in Staten Island, New York. Unlike the stage play and film versions, the TV show was set in the then modern era of the late 1980s. Martin Vanderhof lives in a Victorian home with his daughter Penny, her husband Paul and Essie and Alice, their daughters. Mr. Pinner is a neighbor.

name: The Second Time is Also Fine
Beneath the Contract
summary: Ruan Su married Bo Xingzhi, the president of Bo Group, out of gratitude. However, Bo Xingzhi mistakenly believed that Ruan Su was only after his money and considered their relationship to be nothing more than a contractual marriage, thus showing disdain for Ruan Su...

name: Mama na prenájom
summary: Mama na prenájom is a touching and suspenseful story in which the paths of two families cross thanks to chance and a little girl's wish to get to know her mother... Martin Toman, a successful gynaecologist and co-owner of a prestigious obstetric clinic, raises a kindergarten girl, Hana, alone with her father Ed. Her mother left them so long ago that Hanka doesn't remember her at all. However, Martin has unwisely promised Hanka that her mother will come for her sixth birthday, and now she has no idea how he will fulfill his promise. She finds unexpected salvation in the unbridled and somewhat crazy Nadi Vernerova, who runs the family restaurant with her father Dušan and siblings Beata and Juraj. Hana and Nadia are united by the fact that Nadia's mother has long been absent from the Verners' lives. The meeting of Nadia and Martin triggers a sequence of unexpected twists and events that will eventually intertwine the two families, flushing out dark secrets of the past while giving Hanka hope that one day she will indeed find her dream mother.

name: Rak Salap Lai
summary: When twin sisters who are complete opposites face a turning point that forces them to "switch places" for an important task, things take an unexpected turn.

name: Лига обманутых жен
summary: Adultery has become so common and widespread that it does not even cause public condemnation. But when any particular woman, like the heroine of the film Larisa, unexpectedly encounters the infidelity of her own husband, she experiences it acutely, and other people's experience and other people's experiences offer little comfort. Although... As an energetic and pragmatic person, Larisa did not dwell on her grief, especially since fate specifically brings her together with women who have survived a similar blow. And she decides to unite them into the League of Betrayed Wives. In order to take revenge on unfaithful husbands. But life, as we know, brings its own surprises to our calculations, and what happened as a result of revenge will become clear only at the end of the film.

name: A Calm Sea and Beautiful Days with You
summary: During the Showa-era, newlyweds Natsumi Ebata and Takimasa Ebata enter an arranged marriage without a single day of courtship. Through tender yet exasperating moments, the two slowly bridge the gap between them, discovering love in the quiet routines of their shared days.

name: I Remember Your Temperature
summary: It tells the story of the growth and love of jewelry designer Gu Nanxi. Gu Nanxi was in a car accident before the jewelry design competition, lost her sense of touch and was abandoned by her ex-boyfriend Xiao Rui. Three years later, Gu Nanxi returned to China, but her sense of touch had not fully recovered, and she was struggling in the design industry. By chance, she met the well-known artist Qin Shiqi, and with the help of Qin Shiqi, her sense of touch miraculously recovered. Gu Nanxi went to work at Keger Jewelry, where her ex-boyfriend Xiao Rui worked, and found that Xiao Rui not only abandoned her, but also stole her design results. Facing Xiao Rui's conspiracy, Gu Nanxi gradually won respect with her talent and perseverance, and fell in love with Qin Shiqi. However, their relationship encountered many obstacles, including the opposition of Gu Nanxi's best friend Qin Yufan and Xiao Rui's frame-up. Gu Nanxi finally won the championship of the 6th National Jewelry Design Competition with her strength, exposing Xiao Rui's true face, and overcame many difficulties with Qin Shiqi, harvested a beautiful love, and opened her own jewelry design studio.

name: The Mortician
summary: A darkly gripping series, The Mortician chronicles a trusted family-owned funeral home that hid behind a façade of decency and propriety to take advantage of loved ones at their most vulnerable moments. In the early 1980s, David Sconce, scion of the Lamb family, took over the family business and sought to exploit the deceased in numerous ways to expand their earnings. Driven by profit, the Lamb Funeral Home in Pasadena, California engaged in years of morally questionable and inhumane practices.

name: Big Brother: Unlocked
summary: Big Brother: Unlocked features former winners hosting a deep-dive companion show to Big Brother, guiding viewers through never-before-seen footage, exclusive interviews, and behind-the-scenes access to analyze gameplay and offer an ultimate fan experience

name: Интервидение
summary:
История конкурса Интервидение начинается с 1977 года. Можно считать, что конкурс начал свою историю в 1965 году с проведения международного телевизионного конкурса эстрадной песни «Золотой ключ» в Чехословакии, который проходил ежегодно до 1968 года. Однако официальное название «Интервидение» было принято только в 1977 году в Польше. Международный фестиваль популярной песни, который стал важной платформой для обмена культурным опытом и творческими достижениями между странами.
2025 год - Возрождение конкурса Интервидение.

name: Faking It
summary:
The iconic and award-winning Faking It is back and putting a new generation of fakers to the test. 

In each episode, a brave volunteer is dropped into a completely alien world and given just four weeks – and help from a handful of mentors – to master a new skill and convince a panel of experts that they are the real deal.

name: The Name's the Same
summary: Guests who have the same name as famous persons, fictional characters, or things, are quizzed by celebrity panelists who try to determine their name.

name: Esh Esh
summary: Born into beauty and poverty, Esh Esh is forced into becoming a dancer. She unexpectedly enters the world of the Greitleys, only to discover that her tragic fate was written long before she ever took the stage.

name: Inuk
summary: Seven-year-old Inuit boy Inuk receives a magical amulet letting him talk to animals. With his friends, he embarks on a journey to discover his place in the world.

name: Piripenguins
summary: Five fun, unpredictable penguin pals learn about life, friendship and working together in their iceberg colony. Jump in at the deep end with Pancake, Nugget, Brinicle, Looph and Flutter for some flippertastic adventures.

name: Karine et la maison jaune
summary: Karine et la maison jaune follows Karine Vanasse's new project: renovating an ancestral home bought on a whim.

name: Renovation Hunters
summary:
Introducing Renovation Hunters, a new network original where home improvement meets the outdoor lifestyle. Hosted by Hal Shaffer, hunter and outdoorsman, this show is dedicated to preserving the family tradition of the outdoors. Our mission is to ensure that your hunting, fishing, or vacation camp can be passed on to the next generation.

Our talented crew of Renovation Hunters is made of home improvement specialists from all over the United States, that love both their craft and the outdoors! If your selected, they will dedicate their skills for a solid week to do whatever it takes to ensure that your family camp is the place that your family memories will continue. See the trials, mishaps, and fun as the Renovation Hunters come to your town to preserve your family camp so you can enjoy the great outdoors again!

name: Nurturing Hope
summary: A heart-warming factual series that follows Kaikohe mother, first language speaker Clara Aperahama Kopa and her severely disabled son Mungzy, as they return for their second round of life-saving treatment at the world-renowned NAPA Therapy centre.

name: Generation Dating
summary: Generation Dating is a dating show designed to find out if you can really put an old head on young shoulders. Or ignite a young flame in an old heart. Each episode takes two perfect strangers, one older one younger and sets each of them a challenge: find the perfect date.

name: Next Level
summary: In this original series from Scripps News, we dive into the real-world influence of gaming — from its impact on technology and entertainment to politics and culture at large.

previousepisode.name: Video games changed how we think about music

name: Домохозяин
summary: Operative Anton Shatalin from Semigorsk got bogged down in his work. To pay attention to the family, on his rare day off, Anton arranges a picnic, during which his wife disappears...

name: Summer in the Scilly Isles
summary: Fern Britton narrates this series that explores the close-knit community on Scilly.

name: Si Fa Suo De Gu Shi
Forging Justice
summary: Set against the backdrop of China's early Reform and Opening-Up era, the story spans the years leading up to the 1997 revisions of the Criminal Procedure Law and the Criminal Law. The central characters, Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Zhang Lihui, Xia Yingjie, and their fellow law school graduates, embark on careers in different branches of the justice system after graduation. Through the fast-paced evolution of judicial practice, they witness history, help shape it, adapt to the changing times, and grow both professionally and personally. Coming from different backgrounds and possessing distinct personalities, the group experiences the highs and lows of work and life over more than a decade, ultimately following very different paths. Told from the unique perspective of China's evolving judicial system, the drama brings together judges, prosecutors, police officers, and legal professionals to depict the sweeping history of the country's rule of law, while weaving together the intertwined fates of its characters amid a transformative era.

name: Losmen Bu Broto: The Series
summary: For the Broto family, managing their beloved Yogyakarta inn is no easy feat — especially when their youngest son falls in love with a married guest.

name: Talking Language with Ernie Dingo
summary: Ernie Dingo goes on a personal journey in order to get a unique understanding of how Aboriginal languages are shaped by ancestral connections to the land, stars, water, sea and the air we breathe.

name: Metro Medico
summary: Gu Xiaofeng goes to Haicheng to combat a plague, only to be ambushed and thrown into a lake. In her fading consciousness, she glimpses the silhouette of Ren Yi. When she awakens in the modern world, she resolves to stay by Dr. Ren Yi's side to uncover the truth—thus begins a tale that transcends two worlds.

name: James Martin's Midweek Menu
summary: Not content with hosting his Saturday Morning show, James Martin is now taking over our midweek afternoons. He hosts the series from his home in the Hampshire countryside, where he'll be revisiting favourite recipes from the aforementioned weekend show.

name: Wode Shixiong Tai Qiang Le
summary: A cultivator named Lü Shaoqing accidentally obtains an immortal treasure called *Chunqiu Jie* (Spring and Autumn Ring). Because of this, he is labeled as a world-destroying demon by the Righteous Dao Alliance and hunted down to his death. However, he unexpectedly travels back in time a thousand years. To his shock, he now shares the same body with the very enemy who killed him! Trapped in the enemy's stronghold, Lü Shaoqing must fight cunningly to seize control of his own body. At the same time, he gathers various rare treasures to strengthen himself. As a result, he becomes the most despised figure among the so-called righteous path—an unrestrained wanderer like no other! As his journey unfolds, the hidden secrets of the cultivation world gradually surface. When Lü Shaoqing calculates the course of history, he realizes one thing—the fate of this world has already changed!

name: Love of the Two Realms
summary: When a love story between a human and a crocodile begins, how will it end? Can they truly love each other? And will they be able to restore peace to the waters?

name: Tun Tian Ji
summary: Tun Tian Ji depicts the legendary transformation of the young Wu Yu from a mortal to an immortal Buddha.

name: Thun Thai
summary: Six stories from six different regions of Thailand: North, South, Isan, Central, East, and West.

name: Love in Red Dust
summary: It tells the story of Wen Dingyi, the daughter of a high-ranking official, who suffered the destruction of her family and disguised herself as a man to become the apprentice of an executioner. As a result, she happened to meet the twelfth brother of the current emperor, Yuwen Hongce. The two teamed up to explore the truth and encountered various funny accidents. From then on, they followed each other and started a warm, interesting and crisis-ridden journey in the world.

name: Sľub
summary: Sľub, set in the 1980s, will transport viewers, through strong stories full of emotions, humor, and drama, to a turning point forty years ago, when jeans could only be found in Tuzex, Spartakiad was practiced in free time, people knew that there was a different world beyond the borders, and the word emigration was only spoken in whispers... The plot takes place in an elementary school, which intertwines not only the destinies of students and teachers, but also entire families, which are marked by events in our country and in the surrounding world.

name: Sports Gone Wrong
summary: Each episode of Sports Gone Wrong blends comedic commentary with archival footage to break down jaw-dropping sports debacles — from controversial rule-breaking athletes and over-eager fans stealing home runs to infamous on-air moments, out-of-control fights, public scandals, unlikely injuries, and more. Salley, Godfrey, Smetana, and Virzi react to questionable NFL team theme songs; test Michael Jordan's cologne; play "Shaq Fu;" give their take on the infamous 1996 Orioles-Yankees Jeffrey Maier playoff game; pick sides in the 1984 Copa del Rey final brawl; and much more.

name: 96 Frames
summary: When Lukas wakes up after a heavy night of partying with no memory, he discovers a video circulating online in which he appears to murder someone. He flees in panic. With the help of Noa, the roommate of his missing girlfriend Ravi, he tries to find out what happened. But is Lukas as innocent as he claims? And why is Noa so keen to help him? Can she be trusted?

name: Discovered by Disaster
summary: Throughout history, extreme weather events and catastrophic disasters - both natural and human made - have scarred and reshaped the Earth's surface. Though these events can wreak terrible destruction, they can also uncover incredible things. This documentary reveals mysterious curiosities that were once hidden from human eyes, only to be exposed by a calamitous incident.

name: Toradora SOS!: Kuishinbou Banbanzai
summary: Toradora SOS!: Hurray for Foodies is a set of four chibi-style comedy shorts bundled exclusively with the even-numbered Japanese Toradora! DVD volumes (2, 4, 6, and 8). Focused on lighthearted, food-themed adventures, the episodes feature recurring gags like Ryūji's trivia being ignored and Yūsaku declaring every contest a draw. These specials were never aired on TV and were released only as DVD bonus content, later included in some international editions.

previousepisode.name: 食わず嫌いはよくないよ! 愛してやまない、いとおしいピンクの霜降りコンビーフ

name: Hishakai Shindo
summary:
Shuichirou is in the habit of sneaking into the terrace of his school building during lunch, while skipping class, or when he wants to put off going home. There, he often meets with Konno. Konno is a guy shrouded in rumour: with some saying he's dark and intimidating but others claiming he's a photography enthusiast and an unexpectedly nice guy.

Jealousy, envy, and an odd sort of mutual regard colours the interactions between these two young men: one who conceals his feelings behind a cheerful facade and the other whose simple-minded, pure-hearted demeanour makes his friend's previously avoidant existence rife with internal conflict...

name: Strangers
summary: When a long-neglected housewife befriends a mysterious woman who is her polar opposite, the two women find that they have far more in common than they thought. As their friendship unfolds, we soon learn that they both harbor secrets that could quickly unravel their quiet suburban lives.

name: The Manipulated
summary: A blood-red revenge drama in which a man who was living normally returns from hell when his life suddenly falls into abyss one day.

name: Diary of a Spinster
summary: A Saudi man is past the usual marriageable age, which makes him vulnerable to numerous family and societal pressures urging him to marry. His mother and those close to him try to help him find a suitable wife, but he tries to evade them in various ways.

name: Jesy Nelson: Life After Little Mix
summary: Jesy Nelson: Life After Little Mix follows Jesy Nelson as she embarks on the most transformative journey yet - motherhood. With her life in the public eye for over a decade as one -fourth of the global pop phenomenon Little Mix, Jesy has experienced the highest of highs and the lowest of lows. Now, she's ready to share her truth like never before.

name: Druhá šanca
summary: Dr. Andrej Fabián is one of the best internal medicine doctors in Slovakia, but his relationship with his patients is completely impersonal. He doesn't call them by their names, but by their bed number. He is not interested in their personal lives, only in their laboratory reports. Zero empathy, zero compassion, zero emotional involvement. One night, however, the personal life of a patient who died in his ward catches up with him cruelly: the patient's father, distraught with grief, shoots him in the head. Fabian does not die, but when he wakes up, he quickly realizes that what has happened to him may be far worse than death: the head wound has erased all his memories of the past twelve years. The only thing Fabian can cling to to keep from falling into despair is to get back to his work. But something has changed in him: being a patient has completely upended his approach to medicine. And although he cannot now rely on his medical knowledge, which is 12 years old, he can use his renewed capacity for emotional engagement.

name: Tomáš a Diana
summary: Life as a couple brings many challenges and problems that partners or spouses have to overcome every day. The unconventional series format is made up of short, entertaining clips that give an insight into the everyday life of a mature couple. It presents scenes from everyday partner life and offers advice on how to prevent conflicts or, when they do arise, how to resolve them gracefully.

name: Vina
summary: The story of the series takes place in the picturesque and somewhat sleepy town of Tichý Brod, surrounded by beautiful nature, whose peaceful atmosphere and relations between the inhabitants are disturbed by the brutal murder of an 11-year-old boy, Daniel. The investigation is led by local police captain Elena Mikušová (Gabriela Marcinková) together with her new colleague, Major Adam Hanzel (Tomáš Maštalír), whose aloof and socially inept approach initially complicates their cooperation. Gradually, however, they uncover not only the clues leading to the killer, but also the secrets that the town's inhabitants have been hiding from the others for years... The new series is a Slovak adaptation of the successful British format Broadchurch. The original series was a worldwide success and won millions of fans with its captivating story that reveals human fates and dark secrets against the backdrop of a shocking murder.

name: Nuevo Rico, Nuevo Pobre
summary: What happens when you find out your entire world was never meant for you? An affluent man and his ordinary counterpart find out in a hilarious life swap.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Una boda cuádruple une a los Ferreira y los Galindo

name: The Dream Maker
summary: In the early 1980s, Pingchuan County decided to set up "Yuehai Town" in order to accelerate development. Li Qiu Ping and Zheng De Cheng, two cadres with outstanding abilities and personalities, adhered to the concept of "the people's city is built by the people", and with the help of the reform and opening-up policy and the Central Document No. 1, they found a way to reform and led thousands of farmers to build a modern city on the tidal flats through the "fund-raising and partnership" initiative without using a penny from the state.

name: A Prophet
summary: A mysterious sect manipulates fate to scam the innocent. When revenge driven Shangguan Chengming crosses paths with his enemy Jiang Feiyan again, he sets a trap, using deception against deceivers. But as schemes collide and twists unfold, the game grows more dangerous, who will outsmart whom in the end?

name: Ex on the Beach France
summary: 8 singles move into a villa, unaware that their exes will soon arrive with good or bad intentions. Their dream vacation turns into a real nightmare.

name: A CARography
summary: Interesting profiles on legendary automobiles, manufacturers and personalities.

name: Train Rescue Down Under
summary: The documentary series, Train Rescue Down Under, follows trains, railway workshops and the people working on the trains from across Australia.

previousepisode.name: The Heat is on to Crane in a Rooftop Air Con

name: American Monster: Abuse of Power
summary: Power gave them access. Evil drove their crimes. Prepare for a chilling investigation into some of the darkest stories in modern crime history. Each episode reveals the terrifying truth of abuse of power committed by those in positions of authority.

name: Крутые берега
summary: Olga Morozova, an investigator of the Moscow Prosecutor's office for particularly important cases, returns to her hometown of Bliznerechensk to take care of her mother, who was robbed the day before. Olga cannot leave her mother alone in such a difficult condition and decides to move to the province.

name: Грибной царь
summary: The life of businessman Mikhail Dmitrievich Svirelnikov is going quite well. But he understands perfectly well that his ex-wife, mistress and daughter want only one thing from him - money. In order to provide for them, Mikhail has to commit fraud. One day, noticing surveillance, Svirelnikov understands that someone has revealed his secrets, and begins his investigation...

name: Сёстры Королёвы
summary: A film about love, about life, about betrayal, and about how to overcome the troubles that we create for ourselves throughout our lives. This is the story of the reunion of the three Korolev sisters.

name: Неудачников.net
summary:
A story about the life of our contemporary Alexander Novgorodtsev, forty-two years old, from his four friends, each of whom defends his own version of what happened.

But, no matter how much all four of them disagree in their assessment of certain events, they agree on one thing: their Sashka is the last romantic idealist who managed to perform an "ordinary miracle", usually called "success", to reach "amazing heights" and at the same time not bend one iota to the changing world.

The boaster Valentin, the emotional Mikhail, the gallant Igor and the reasonable Veniamin lead their narrative.

name: Любовь и прочие глупости
summary: The heroes of the series are clients of an ordinary beauty salon "Faces". As usual, when they come to the salon, they tell their, sometimes the most incredible, stories of Love. Some of them are impossible to believe, others will turn out to be just a figment of their imagination and not all will end with a happy ending. The beauty salon will become that "magical" place where everyone will reveal their most intimate love secrets: different and at the same time close to each other. And the grateful listeners will be the visitors of the salon and, of course, its employees.

name: Жил-был дед
summary: 60-year-old businessman Pyotr Gavrilovich Kuznetsov is a handsome man in the prime of life. He is not used to denying himself pleasures and bathes in luxury, having fun with his young mistress. But suddenly everything changes: a terrible illness takes away his former strength, and his life collapses before his eyes. His son, with whom Pyotr Gavrilovich has not communicated for many years, is in no hurry to help, and the woman, who was recently burning with passion, runs away from him without a second thought...

name: Своя команда
summary: An ordinary high school has a basketball section that all eighth-graders want to get into. But the path is open only to a select few, because the invited coach Sergeeva has her own strict selection criteria. Those who are unlucky decide to succeed in basketball at any cost. Many obstacles arise on their way, but the guys overcome them all and prove to others that they, too, can become an equally strong and friendly basketball team. And most importantly, the boys and girls become a team for life! Each episode is a complete story, a significant episode from the lives of very different teenagers who are united by "Your Team". They solve problems, achieve success, fall in love. They become Personalities!

name: The Mill on the Floss
summary: The tragic tale of Maggie Tulliver, the miller's daughter, who defies her embittered brother in standing by the man she loves - shocking the stifling society in which she lives - in an attempt to pursue her blighted dreams

name: The Kouncil
summary: Katie navigates adulthood post-breakup, guided by her inner voices: Logic, Heart, Anxiety, and Lady Parts. She faces life's challenges while balancing desires and needs, learning to accept all aspects of herself through humor and growth.

name: Scrubs
summary: Old friends JD and Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time, learning that medicine has changed; interns have changed; but their bromance has stood the test of time.

name: Love For You
summary: In the 1990s, Chen Yi and Miao Jing grow up together but are separated by tragedy and a criminal case. Years later, they reunite, fight a crime network, and finally end up together.

name: Naši
summary: Naši presents the life of a family of five with occasional slightly ironic undertones, so natural for normal relationships between children and parents. Every week, a father and mother struggling to raise their three sons invite us into their daily routine and offer us a tasty cocktail of varied emotions, laughter and screams. Every parent can easily identify with their stories and situations full of humour, but also tenderness and heart-warming human warmth. They provoke us to laugh, smile or think, and the occasional gnashing of teeth cannot be ruled out. Our heroes undoubtedly succeed in dramatically changing the optics through which we view the contemporary family, while sending a reassuring signal to us all that we parents - or our children - are not alone in this.

name: Shadow Punisher
summary: In the 37th year of the Hongyun era, the Great Shi Dynasty is about to meet bloodshed. Liluo, a fallen nation, has risen from the ashes with its "Five Extraordinary Mystical Arts," creating one terrifying mystery after another. Fortunately, the Divine Constable Bureau, an elite investigative force under the imperial court, is led by Li Si and his group. Determined to protect the people and nation, they launch a deadly battle against the remnants of Liluo. Nine coffins contain the dried corpses of young women, all drained of blood. What caused their tragic ends? Within the Black Wind Forest, a Tianmoluo plant feeds on 36 boys. Amid a field of flowers bearing human bodies wrapped in cocoons, the scent of Dead Bone Spice, refined from women's blood, fills the air. In the lake within the Southeast Ship Lord's manor, corpses drift upon the waves. A boy transforms into a werewolf under the moonlight. An elder ascends to immortality in public. Villagers in a secluded settlement mutate into bloodthirsty madmen. And the Crown Prince's dead grandson continues to move about as if nothing had happened.The crimes of Liluo are beyond measure, and the Divine Constable Bureau must bring them to justice and restore peace to the Great Shi Dynasty.

name: Mr. Scorsese
summary: Explore the many lives of Martin Scorsese through intimate interviews with the man himself, access to his private archives, plus conversations with Robert De Niro, Leonardo DiCaprio, Margot Robbie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Steven Spielberg, and more.

name: Ahoy Pirates!
summary: Three pirate girls travel on a ship and explore unknown lands searching for a treasure.

name: Airport 24/7
summary:
Narrated by The Project's own frequent flyer and funny woman Susie Youssef, this series taxis viewers behind the scenes of Melbourne Airport, Australia's busiest 24-hour runway to the world.

Last year, 35 million passengers and thousands of flights passed through its terminals. But behind every seamless departure and arrival is a team of dedicated professionals working around the clock to ensure the airport runs safely and efficiently.

This gripping documentary series follows the air traffic controllers who navigate congested skies, ensuring aircraft land and take off without a hitch. On the ground, baggage handlers, security teams, customs officers, and emergency responders work tirelessly to keep everything moving, often under intense pressure.

Whether it's managing last-minute flight diversions, responding to medical emergencies, or handling unexpected security threats, every shift presents a new challenge.

With exclusive access to restricted areas and high-pressure moments, this is your boarding pass to the world behind the departures board — a place where no two days are the same and every second counts.

So fasten your seatbelts, stow your tray tables, and prepare for departure — because Airport 24/7 is about to land on your screens.

name: Sherri Papini: Caught in the Lie
summary: For the first time, Papini shares her account of events as she recalls them, offering rare insights into her mindset during her disappearance and the subsequent investigation into her abduction claims upon her return home.

name: Химкинские ведьмы
summary: Three con artists Marina, Sveta and Olya successfully pose as mediums until they accidentally receive a real gift from a street witch. Now Marina can hear thoughts, Sveta can see the future, and Olya can see the dead. New abilities turn the girls' lives into hell, so the friends decide to find someone who will take these "gifts" for themselves. In search of the perfect candidate, the girls meet not only the insidious sorcerer-tempter, but also the second halves.

name: Crookhaven
summary:
The thrilling family adventure series is set at mysterious Crookhaven School where high achieving young crooks from across the world are secretly selected to hone their skills in disciplines such as Deception, Crimnastics, Forgery and Infiltration, learning how to use their skills for good and to do what is right in their own way. 

Centred around pickpocketing genius Gabriel and his archrival, headmaster's daughter Penelope, the series follows a group of eight very different, young international students as they compete for the coveted Crooked Cup.  

In a school where every teacher is a crook and traitors lurk around every corner, no-one is entirely who they seem to be as the gang uncover the dark secrets that link Penelope's missing mother with Gabriel's own mysterious past and confront a terrifying enemy - The Nameless.   

 A coming-of-age drama full of exciting twists and turns, Crookhaven is about finding your place in the world, learning who you can trust and the very nature of right and wrong.

name: Тайная жизнь Маргариты
summary: Margarita lives a double life. In one life, she is a modest literature teacher at school, a wonderful wife and mother. In the other, she is a bright and mysterious singer at a night restaurant. The heroine performs in a mask under the pseudonym Greta and carefully hides her identity not only from the public, but also from her family: her mother, daughter Zhenya and husband Victor. However, deception plays a cruel joke on her. During one of her performances, Margo notices her husband in the audience in the arms of his mistress Vika, the daughter of his boss. She decides to follow them, but eventually finds Vika dead. Margarita realizes that all suspicions will now fall on her. In addition, the girl's influential father will not stop until he finds the killer and punishes him. This means that Margo's fate is unenviable. Together with Victor, Margo decides not to go to the police, but to hide the girl's body in the forest. So the heroine finds herself in a trap from which there seems to be no way out...

name: Três Graças
summary: It tells the story of Gerluce, a woman of the people, who did everything to prevent her teenage daughter from repeating the fate of her mother and grandmother, Lígia. But when her heiress becomes pregnant, the young woman is capable of a desperate act.

Elizaveta Listova's documentary is dedicated to one of the most tense and least known periods of the Cold War. Unlike the Cuban Missile Crisis, when the world stood on the brink of nuclear war in front of everyone's eyes, the events of 1983 developed in such a spontaneous way that humanity could perish without even realizing what had actually happened.

In 1983, at the peak of a zealous political battle with its salvos of the main propaganda calibers, a whole series of random events occurs, each of which only miraculously does not become the beginning of the end of civilization.

On the night of September 1, 1983, a foreign plane was shot down by the Soviet military off the Far Eastern coast, having penetrated more than 500 kilometers into the country's airspace. By all indications, the plane was an American reconnaissance aircraft - such aircraft often flew along the coast of the USSR, but it turned out to be a civilian aircraft of Korean Airlines, which for unknown reasons had deviated from its usual course.

Almost a month later, at the command post of the space echelon of the missile attack warning system, an alert was triggered about the launch of nuclear missiles by the Americans towards the USSR. The entire political background spoke of the regularity of this event. But in the few minutes that were given to the combat crew to analyze the situation, the commander of this crew figured out that the alert was false, a malfunction of the system itself, and interrupted the chain of information that would inevitably lead to the command to launch nuclear missiles in response.

But a month later, the strategic forces of the Soviet Union were put on heightened combat readiness. Because, according to the Soviet military, the American strategic forces were put on readiness No. 1 - "a nuclear war is inevitable." It took titanic operational efforts by the intelligence services of the USSR and the GDR to understand that the highest combat readiness declared by the Americans was a training exercise. NATO countries were conducting large-scale exercises to practice launching nuclear missiles with new codes and a radio silence regime that left their opponents no chance to distinguish the exercises from reality. This could have been another point of no return. And the Americans did not immediately learn about the Soviet Union's hyperreaction. And when they did, they did not immediately believe that the Union seriously feared that the United States would use nuclear weapons first.

Both of these potentially fatal incidents were never public knowledge. But they are the ones that bring the most important player to the field of political games - chance. The documentary film "1983" will be devoted to the role of chance in history.

name: 45 дней до Победы
summary: 45 дней до Победы is a project dedicated to the heroic deeds of people during the Great Patriotic War. Pioneer partisans, scientists of besieged Leningrad, signalmen, artists, athletes, nurses, translators, priests - none of them were ready for war, but each made an invaluable contribution to bringing the long-awaited Victory closer. Each episode reflects one year of a terrible period for the country - from the beginning of the invasion to the final defeat of the enemy in 1945.

name: Невидимки
summary: Mom, dad, two sons, one at the institute, the other works as a bodyguard. If you look at them, they seem like an ordinary family. If you meet one of them in a crowd of city passers-by, you won't pay attention to them – they are invisible. This is only to their advantage, because while you don't notice them, they look at you and see everything that you would hardly want to show to anyone. Everything falls into place when you learn the past of Larisa and Viktor (mom and dad): until recently, they worked in the seventh department of the KGB. Today they are already retired, but, as we know, there are no former employees of the security services, and they continue to engage in surveillance privately and on private orders.

name: Hal & Harper
summary: Hal & Harper are codependent siblings doing their best to navigate long-term relationships, friendships, and situationships. When their dad makes a big announcement, the two are forced to consider the current state of their lives and their complicated childhood.

name: Desagertuta
summary: A viral video. A group of friends. And a disappearance that changes everything. Jon disappears after a night of partying on Mt. The only clue: a video recorded hours earlier. Is it a heavy joke or is it a real disappearance? Everyone has reason to hate him... Is he alive or dead?

name: The Sparkle in Your Eye
summary: After suffering a scandal, former star Pei Jia decides to make a fresh start as an actor to remake his image. His co-star turns out to be Su Yi, a total rookie with no acting experience. In order to get on the same wavelength, the two are forced to live together and share a bed. Their relationship starts to turn ambiguous against the pressure of the entertainment industry, as Pei Jia has to fight for not just his work, but also the man he loves.

previousepisode.name: Tell the whole world you are my lover

name: Mesto tieňov
summary: Tomáš Benkovský  arrives at the Department of Violent Crime in Bratislava. His father, a forensic pathologist, has arranged a place for him. Apart from Tomáš, his team includes Oliver, Sergej, Rudo . The psychologist Jana also works in the department. The head of the whole department is Milan. Alongside the investigation of crimes, the lives of Ivan and Tomáš are also revealed. Ivan has a problem with his daughter, and it spills over into his relationship with his wife. Tomáš, in turn, moves into an apartment with his girlfriend - journalist Lucia. Meanwhile, Tomáš has a damaged relationship with his father, whom he meets at work - he blames him for his workaholism and blames him for his mother's accident, which left her in a wheelchair.

name: Moon and Dust
summary: Raised by his brother Song Li, Song Qi's deep dependence turns into obsessive love. As Song Li seeks a normal life, Song Qi's possessiveness spirals into madness, pushing their bond into a painful battle between love and control

name: ИМПЕРИЯ ХОББИХОРСИНГА
summary: The EMPIRE OF HOBBYHORSING is the first hobbyhorsing media tournament in the history of mankind. 8 star participants compete in a "ride" on a wooden stick with a horse's head, and professional and star judges decide which of the riders is the best. There are 4 duels waiting for you, the winner of each one goes to the finals, where the world's first Emperor of Hobbyhorsing will be determined.

name: Я так вижу
summary: Ilya Satyr is a new interviewer. But doing interviews based on classics is boring. That's why in this show he calls the guests, makes parodies of them, shows them these parodies in person - and asks for a comment.

name: Магия сердца
summary: After her mother's death, Mila becomes her father's support both at home and in business. But the family situation gets tense when her father gets close to the fortune teller Albina. Mila doesn't believe in the sincerity of Albina's feelings and, having quarreled with her father on this basis, decides to start an independent life. She leaves the family business and accidentally meets the charming psychic Sergei, hoping that thanks to his abilities she will expose her stepmother. Having become close to Sergei, Mila realizes that she has fallen in love, although she has a fiancé... Nevertheless, the young people begin to work together and become a real team. And Sergei's gift really helps to shed light on the circumstances of Mila's life and her loved ones.

name: ГIБДД i т.д
summary:
This is a story about the work of an ordinary traffic police department (the old-fashioned way of saying - GAI) of one of the administrative districts of Moscow. The life of a "traffic cop" is full of events of various natures: dramatic, lyrical, sometimes even tragic, but more often, fortunately, comedic. The series will show the life and work of the traffic police department, through the prism of which the characters, experiences and aspirations of ordinary people, ordinary citizens of Russia working in this "unusual ordinary" profession are refracted. She left her mark on each of them. In someone, she emphasized the best qualities, someone pushed to develop all the worst.

The plot is based on the story of the senior duty officer Ogoshkov, who, because of his love for the girl Inga, finds himself drawn into criminal machinations. His fellow traffic cops will have to solve these crimes. The series will have a place for chases, and romantic encounters, and personal dramas, and real men's actions.

name: Tou Wo Yanfa Chengguo Hou, Wo Zhenjing ShiJie
Bloomberg Businessweek Daily
summary: Reporting that helps global leaders stay ahead, plus insight on the people, companies and trends.

name: Русские амазонки
summary: Story about three nice Russian girls, who work at amateur flying club.

name: Bloomberg: The Close
summary: Alix Steel, Romaine Bostick and Scarlet Fu own the market-moving breaking news around the closing bell; a synthesis focusing on the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street.

name: Ladrones: la tiara de santa Águeda
summary: The series introduces Amber, one of the world's most brilliant thieves who, after a failed robbery in Las Vegas, prepares her next heist. This time, it will be on Hope Island, a paradise lost in the middle of the Pacific. Her target is the Saint Agatha Tiara, a jewel valued at $240 million, which the daughter of Mexican oil magnate Emilio Villegas will wear at her wedding. To prepare for the robbery, Amber has spent three years undercover as a governess in the Villegas family. But her meticulous plan goes awry when Rui, a brazen and mysterious thief with whom she had a complicated relationship in Las Vegas during a spectacular heist, appears on the island.

name: Nemocnica
summary: In a place where lives are at stake every day, there seems to be no room for anything else, let alone the doctors' own lives. But doctors are only human too, and so it often happens that where there is no room for personal failure, such failure must inevitably occur. The daily struggle for life in the emergency room, and whether God is watching over the patient or everything is solely in the hands of the doctors, brings many traumas, eternal questions and dilemmas to the doctors themselves. Two young doctors arrive at the central reception, still carrying their ideals and ideas from the faculty. These disappear with a flick of a wand when they enter a real hospital, where they are both attested. Agáta and Braňo also have a shared past, which did not go well at school, and so a natural medical rivalry develops between them. Superficiality, superiority, heart, compassion and solidarity are the themes that the doctors deal with day in and day out, and each of them brings their own spin to the job. Every day there is something new to learn, and often the protagonists come to understand that they are not gods. That's probably the hardest lesson of all for the two young doctors who have just arrived and think they can save the world to learn. The doctors at the hospital live their jobs to the fullest, and so have little room to get to know their life partners outside the hospital. Hence, workplace relationships often develop and there is a drawing in of life's vicissitudes and relationship problems right into the ward.

name: Oteckovia
summary: Four fathers were brought together in a kindergarten attended by their offspring. Alex, a lawyer, Marek, a divorcee, Vlado, a pizzeria owner, and Tomáš, a widower, are trying to cope with their lives and their roles as fathers and partners.

name: Vyprávěj
summary: Vyprávěj is a Czech television retroseries. The story takes place in Czechoslovakia (later Czech Republic) and is set in real historical events that influence the stories of the individual characters. The authors evoke the atmosphere of the time with excerpts from contemporary Czechoslovak newsreels with original commentaries, or a new historicizing commentary by Vladimír Fišer, or period music. The story is accompanied by the voice of the narrator, which was lent to the project by actor Vojtěch Kotek and then Matěj Hádek. The series was a great success, one of the most successful projects of Czech Television and is regularly repeated.

name: Fantomet Philip
summary: He fooled everyone – the banks, the millionaires and the police, stole identities, kidnapped and robbed. This is the story of Norway's most cunning fraudster.

name: 4teens
summary: The main characters are only fifteen or sixteen years old at the beginning, having left primary school and starting high school. They are no longer children and they are ready to jump straight into everything. They are going through a period of rebellion against parents and teachers, a period of searching and disappointment, first fateful loves, friendships and enmities. Different types of people meet in the classroom. They have different interests, attitudes, family backgrounds, dreams and different ideas about how to spend their free time. Some are skateboarders, others are nerds, some live for music, others for computers. There are athletes and intellectuals among them. Some are sociable, others are withdrawn. Chatting, computer games and virtual reality are more important to some than real friendship.

name: Genial daneben
summary: Hella von Sinnen, Wigald Boning and the panel guests humorously try to find answers to open questions.

name: Проклятый рай
summary: An elite brothel for VIPs. Here, hot caresses are sold and serious passions boil. A well-oiled criminal mechanism has failed: one of the new girls is killed. In order not to jeopardize her well-being, the middle-aged manager of the brothel decides to cover up the matter as quickly as possible. To do this, she calls the head of security - a cynical, ruthless thug nicknamed Cain - and orders him to eliminate the girl's mother... The cruel laws of the big city, the delights of criminal love, the weaknesses of the powerful. What is life "on the other side" of morality - and what is it, the code of dishonor?

name: Летучий отряд
summary: They are called "Flying Squad". They report directly to the Economic Counterintelligence Directorate. They are the best people in their profession! The glorious five: the head of the group - Lieutenant Colonel Kirsanov, Senior Lieutenant Grushin, Major Artemyev, the beautiful investigator Kalugina and Captain Tarasyuk. "Flying Squad" is entrusted with a task of special importance: to ensure the security of the state border, catch criminals and punish werewolves in uniform.

name: Последняя минута
summary:
Four directors, twenty gripping stories, a kaleidoscope of genres from thriller to comedy. Each episode is an hour of real time that the viewer will live together with the characters of the series. An hour that will become a turning point in the characters' destinies, an hour after which nothing will be the same as before...

The format of "The Last Minute" is unusual: there are no through characters, no single story. The episodes are separate short stories, the plots of which develop in real time. The characters live ordinary lives, they have their own concerns, affairs, work, family and secrets. But life can make a sharp turn in an instant, and then everything turns upside down. The secret becomes clear, friends - enemies, chance encounters - fatal... How will the characters of the series act? How will it all end? Who will be the winner, and who will have to part with life? Everything will become clear only at the last minute...

name: Tiempofinal
summary: They begin, develop and end in an hour. In one place and with no more than four characters. High suspense, great police tone, humor, unexpected twists, the viewer does not guess the outcome until the end.

name: Desenlace
summary: Several Thriller Stories in Spain.

name: Tiempo final
summary: A series exploring the final hours of individuals' lives, each episode confined to a single location with no more than three or four characters.

name: Tempo Final
summary: Six unrelated stories of crimes of passion, with a lot of suspense .

name: Cultural Exchange with a Game Centre Girl
summary: Kusakabe Renji, a young man working at a game centre, sees an English girl named Lily Baker playing a crane game on Valentine's Day. Seeing her fail repeatedly to win a prize, Renji can't help but take action. The day after Lily finally gets her plushie, Renji receives an unexpected message from her that reads, "Be my valentine!" What started as a misunderstanding leads to cultural exchange!

name: Klan
summary: The series tells the story of the multi-generational Lubicz family, whose seniors are Maria and Wladyslaw Lubicz. Maria was the owner of the family pharmacy "Pod Modrzewiem", and Wladyslaw was a juvenile court superintendent. During their more than 50 years of married life, they had five children - Elizabeth, Pawel, Monica, Dorothy and Richard - followed by a bunch of grandchildren and several great-grandchildren. Despite adversity and the surprises it cooks up for them, the inevitable conflicts, for the Lubiczes family always comes first. The siblings support each other and can always count on each other in difficult moments. The series depicts the realities of everyday life and raises important social issues.

name: Deixa Que Te Leve
summary: Maria Della Luce Távora Gonzaga Valenti, Duchess of Orvieto, fed up with being chased by the paparazzi, leaves Italy, where she lived with part of her family. Portugal, more specifically Arcos de Valdevez and Peneda, are the refuge chosen by the young woman, who will go by the name of Luz.

name: Maria Corleone
summary: The young Maria Corleone has moved from Palermo, Sicily to Milan and is realizing her dream of becoming a stylist; she has a partner, Luca Spada, a young prosecutor with whom she is expecting a child. Having returned to Sicily for the big party for her parents' wedding anniversary, she is involved in an attack that will change her life forever. Little by little Maria will enter the criminal mechanisms of the mafia, coming to terms with her conscience to defend the life and honor of the Corleones: but this will weigh dramatically on her relationship with Luca and their child.

name: Wish You Were Queer
summary: Follows Michael Henry and Tim Murray, two comedians who for the first time perform standup on the road in North America.

name: Сегодня
summary:
Segodnya (Russian: Сего́дня) is a news program broadcast by Russian broadcaster NTV.

It first began airing on October 10, 1993, the day NTV was founded, and continues to air to this day.

name: Rodinné prípady
summary: The format is based on real stories of ordinary people who have to deal with major life situations. Families are different and life within them is different. Even with the best efforts, parents' child-rearing sometimes gets out of hand and disaster strikes. Other times, they just get mixed up in the wrong crowd and suddenly the whole family has a hell of a life! This is exactly the kind of situation that the new format called Rodinné prípady deals with.

name: Dr. Dokonalý
summary: The series focuses on Daniel Ludsky, a forensic expert and expert diagnostician.

name: Dr. Ludsky
summary:
The original JOJ TV series presents medical stories in a completely different way than before.The fictional stories about medical errors or failures are in many cases inspired by real events.Tomáš Maštalír as MUDr. Daniel Ludsky is an expert on diagnoses and medical malpractice. 
As a forensic expert, he often cooperates with the police. Dr. Ludsky is not the hero we are used to - he is intelligent, uncompromising, arrogant and impatient. He hates sloppiness and incompetence, so he doesn't have many friends among his colleagues. But he believes in the truth and in the patient's right to be treated decently. He is not very happy in private either. He is divorced and, alongside his work, struggles to find time for his teenage daughter.

name: Khadaan
summary: In a mining village shrouded in a dark and sinister past, an entire family is found brutally murdered. Has an angry spirit returned to seek revenge? Has the long-dormant curse been reawakened? Who—or what—is responsible for the hundreds of bodies unearthed during the investigation? Inspector Veer Pratap Singh, who has just arrived in the village to take charge, is thrust into a chilling investigation that will test his resolve and alter the course of his life forever.

name: Infidelity it's a disease
summary: The drama tells the love story of a playboy and a nurse student in a comedy style.

name: The Wimbledon Killer
summary: When Rachel Nickell is stabbed to death on Wimbledon Common in 1992 the police launch the biggest investigation since the Yorkshire Ripper. Colin Stagg is arrested, only for the judge to throw out the case.

name: Emma
summary: She's not just the little sister of Marcus and Martinus, because Emma is following her own dream of becoming an artist.

name: Cold Hunt
summary: Criminal investigator Li Yujing is temporarily assigned to assist female officer Yue Qingchuan in solving a series of child trafficking cases. During the investigation, he unexpectedly uncovers a lead connected to an armed robbery case he handled 13 years ago. Together, the two cross a 13-year gap, unfolding a hard-boiled manhunt across dual timelines.

name: Double Track Puzzle
summary: Zhan Peng's father was a railway policeman who was posthumously honored as a martyr for his sacrifice many years ago. Influenced by that, Zhan Peng had always aspired to follow in his father's footsteps and serve in the very same station where his father once worked. However, when he finally arrived in Xiaotong and began his duties, he discovered that the situation there was far more complex than he had imagined. Upon first meeting Tu Hongjiang, he did not trust this veteran police officer. Tu Hongjiang's suspicious behaviors during the handling of a drug trafficking case even made Zhan Peng wary of him. However, as time passed, Tu Hongjiang proved his innocence through his actions. As they worked together on cases, Zhan Peng gradually developed respect for Tu Hongjiang, and the two eventually joined forces to apprehend the mastermind behind the crimes

name: Vow of the Phoenix
summary: At the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, General Dou Wu was defeated in his fight against the eunuchs' dictatorship, leading to the execution of his entire family. His eight-year-old daughter Dou Ling escaped and vowed revenge. Taking on the alias "Yanhuang", she infiltrated the Caiyi Workshop, an assassin organization controlled by the enemies. Navigating a vortex of slaughter and conspiracy, she bode her time to get closer to her targets, Zhang Huan and Cao Jie, and rose through the ranks with her exceptional wit and martial arts. But as she finally approached Cao Jie, her true identity was at risk of being exposed...

name: Liftoff
summary: LIFTOFF is an adventure series following world-class big wave surfer Niccolo Porcella, and one of the world's best wingsuit pilots, Jokke Sommer, as they attempt to switch sports. The series takes them on a global mission to Hawaii, Dubai, France, Italy, Switzerland, and Norway, assisted by legendary mentors in each other's sports.

name: Легенды и мифы
summary:
The host of the program, Alexander Ingilevich, goes on expeditions to find real prototypes of the heroes of legends, myths and fairy tales.

Deep dive into different historical eras, elements of feature films, amazing finds and sensational discoveries.

Легенды и мифы will prove that much of what is considered fiction actually happened!

name: Легенды советского сыска
summary: These crimes were not written about in the newspapers, not talked about on the radio. Thousands of criminal cases are still classified as "secret". But it is time to penetrate the closed archives. Masterful swindlers, elusive thieves and even serial killers - they also existed in the Soviet era. But there were also those who entered into an "invisible battle" with them. How did detectives work without mobile phones, computers and the most complex examinations? And what criminal secrets were ordered to be forgotten?

name: Jane Austen: Rise of a Genius
summary: The incredible story of a young woman who ripped up the rulebook and reinvented the novel. Famous faces celebrate her remarkable life and beloved stories that still resonate today.

name: Waiata Anthems
summary: Acclaimed music artists from Aotearoa share their deeply personal stories of disconnection, reclamation, vulnerability, and courage when they translate and record songs in te reo Māori.

previousepisode.name: Kora - Kia Arohatia Tātou / All We Need

name: Ball Boy Tactics
summary: After retiring from gymnastics, Han Jiwon thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jungwoo—campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Jiwon thinks he has Jungwoo figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance?

name: Blades Amid Blossoms
summary: When the imperial concubine dies mysteriously among peach blossoms during her visit to Peach Blossom Manor, wandering swordsman Yan Shiyi becomes the prime suspect. Cold Blade, her appointed bodyguard, seals the estate, forbidding anyone to leave. As the inquiry deepens, the manor's hidden sins surface, and the truth grows ever more elusive…

name: In The Name of Loyalty
summary: A master assassin, Cheng Ge, disguises himself as a humble robe attendant to Emperor Shi Yu to carry out his deadliest mission. But as he becomes entangled in the lethal power struggles of the court and its buried secrets from the past, his simple plan unravels. Now, the hunter trapped in his own game must make the ultimate choice: to strike or to protect?

name: The Queen of Attack
summary: Prince Xiao Xian sends men to search for his lover Lin Hong'er, whom he met by chance among the common people. Xu Ziyi, who looks strikingly like Lin Hong'er, takes her place. To keep the secret, the Xu family murders Lin Hong'er's family, leaving her disfigured. After being rescued by the enigmatic wandering doctor Shentu Yu, Lin Hong'er changes her appearance and adopts the alias Hong Linlang, embarking on a path of vengeance.

name: The Demon
summary: Fan Dayao is the notorious Tiger Demon King of Qianchun Mountain, immensely powerful and utterly domineering. Shen Wangchen, the son of the City Lord of Moyuan, was born frail and aloof, keeping his distance from others. Upon reaching adulthood, Shen embarks on a journey to seek out a cat demon in hopes of curing his illness. When the two cross paths, an absurd yet amusing "human - demon cohabitation" begins...

name: Threading Mom's Wings
summary: After dying in a car crash caused by her cheating boyfriend, Jin Xiaowan is reborn in 1999 - as a five-year-old prodigy! Using her modern-day knowledge, she helps her mother, Lin Han, dump toxic men, build a fortune, and even sparks a romance with the wealthy Ying Huiming. But when Xiaowan realizes her mom might also be a reborn soul, their heartwarming mother-daughter duo teams up to rewrite destiny - only to discover Mom has her own secret plans...

name: Moonlit Order
summary: Feng Zuoren, commander of the Snow Feather Guards, infiltrates the Marquis' estate under imperial orders to find and eliminate the former crown prince. Her mission becomes complicated when she crosses paths with the young lord, Xue Hexu. Their initial deadly encounters slowly transform into a complex bond, blossoming into an unexpected affection amidst the domestic intrigue and power struggles! However, they soon discover that a far greater conspiracy is unfolding behind the scenes, masterminded by a hidden puppeteer.

name: She Is the Phoenix
summary: Jiang Leyao, a girl from a humble background, marries into a powerful family, only to be betrayed and brutally tormented by her closest friend and a group of the wealthy and powerful. Her life ends in tragedy until she wakes up back in time. Yet her so-called best friend has also been reborn… And this time, she's stolen Jiang Leyao's place as the bride of high society. But Leyao isn't the only one with secrets. Behind her friend stands a shadowy figure of great power who's been pulling the strings…

name: Above the Clouds
summary: Lu Anning and Ling Cang, bound by a thousand lifetimes of tragic love, are puppets of destiny, from fierce rivals to awakening souls. They join forces in divine cultivation, fighting to break free from fate's cruel game.

name: Ordinácia v ružovej záhrade
summary:
"There are few places in the world where life and death decisions are made. Women know them intimately; men tiptoe around them." The series Ordinacja v rosovej zahrada reveals the thirteenth chamber of medicine, more precisely the gynaecological and obstetric ward of a hospital in an unnamed Slovak town and a private gynaecological clinic.These environments are linked not only by a common mission, but also by the collegial and friendly relations of the main characters. 
The protagonists are not only the doctors and nurses, but also their family members, partners, friends and especially the patients. The protagonists of the series emphasize the psychology of the characters in authentic contemporary "life". The series gives the opportunity for interesting acting performances and the viewer has the opportunity to get to know Slovak actors, well-known faces in the media, who return from the position of presenters and entertainers back to what they do so well on the stage.

The series Ordinacja v rozove zahrada (Ordination in the Rose Garden) has been a huge success in the neighbouring Czech Republic, where it has become a long-running series with high ratings.

name: Dotyk života
summary: Dotyk života is a television series from a medical background in which midwives help bring new lives into the world... Childbirth is one of the few experiences that brings us all together, and the setting is usually a maternity ward, whose staff experience both conflict and the most beautiful joys during the busy days and nights. Outwardly, they are all part of a good-hearted and cohesive team, but sometimes they are subject to enormous mental and physical strain. Like the head midwife, Eva, who is surrounded by new life every day and secretly longs for children of her own, but finds it difficult to forge close relationships. She, her colleagues, and all incoming mothers share this place, a place of fear, uncertainty and guilt, but also a place of trust, laughter, love and the greatest bliss of all, which is the touch of new life.

name: Zombie Warfare
summary: A terrifying plague of rotting corpses sweeps through Xuan City. The occultist Dong Qing emerges to confront the crisis. Before him stand the imposing, righteous City Lord Nan Feng and his gentle, courteous eldest son, Nan Zhengci. Yet, Dong Qing senses something deeply amiss. Is this grotesque epidemic a heavenly punishment or a man-made calamity? He resolves to pierce the veil of doubt and uncover the truth!

name: In aller Freundschaft - Nachts in der Sachsenklinik
summary: What sparks the viewer's imagination more than the question of what the In aller Freundschaft family does when night falls at the Sachsenklinik, the lights go out and the real work is done? In this web series, you can experience a rather unusual side of the Freundschaft stars outside of their everyday hospital life. The Sachsenklinik is anything but black and white at night. The new night porter at the Sachsenklinik, Tom Fichte, who actually hopes to have enough time to watch the broadcasts of his favorite soccer club and, to his horror, barely makes it to the toilet in peace and quiet, learns this too.

name: Paramount
summary: After losing her family and being cast aside by her wealthy husband Qian Muchen, Bai Luo returns from the depths of despair with a new identity—a songstress at the Paramount Club. Behind the glamour, she plots her revenge with chilling precision. This time, she'll make everyone dance in the palm of her hand.

name: Wer weiß denn sowas?
summary: Celebrities answer very difficult questions about everyday things and problems.

name: Gefragt – Gejagt
summary: Gefragt – Gejagt ("Asked - Hunted") is the German adaptation of the British show The Chase. In this beloved show, a team of four candidates competes against a superbrain, the "Hunter". That's not an easy task, as the hunters are proven quiz professionals.

name: Télématin
summary: Télématin is a French television program broadcast on Antenne 2 and then France 2 since January 10, 1985. This morning program offers news and features on culture and daily life. Its concept is based on the American Today program.

name: Most Wanted – Wer entkommt?
summary: Sixteen celebrities attempt a spectacular prison break. Their goal: to remain free for five days while three hunters are hot on their heels. While the hunters are supported by regular GPS data, the targets, who have no money or cell phones, rely on the help of the public. But beware: any citizen could become an informant for their pursuers.

name: Кой да знае?
summary: Кой да знае? is the Bulgarian version of the German TV show Wer weiß denn sowas?. It is a weekday comedy quiz show that airs in primetime on bTV, hosted by Aleksandar Kadiev.

name: ZDF-Fernsehgarten
summary: The ZDF-Fernsehgarten is a entertainment show that is broadcast live from the ZDF broadcasting center in Mainz-Lerchenberg on Sunday mornings from May to September. Around 20 programs are produced each year.

name: Tout le monde a son mot à dire
summary: Daily mental gymnastics to have fun with the French language and enrich your general knowledge.

name: Die Augenzeugen
summary: Two schoolboys who have just discovered a mutual attraction are witnesses to the murder of three gang members. In a mix of fear and embarrassment, the teenagers hope that staying silent will keep them alive.

name: Charming Boys
summary: In this Prince Charming spin-off, former contestants from the dating show and new participants go on a flirtation course. Against a picturesque backdrop, they go on breathtaking dates in search of Mr. Right.

name: La Piste de Xapatan
summary: La Piste de Xapatan was a game show broadcast on Antenne 2 from February 21, 1992 to July 3, 1992, created by Jacques Antoine and presented by Sophie Davant and Grégory Frank.

name: Romil & Jugal
summary: Two men, Jugal and Romil, fall in love with each other but are scared that their orthodox family would not accept them. However, they decide to overcome all their obstacles together.

name: The German
summary: They met immediately after World War II, a man and a woman who lost everything, and despite the traumas they endured they fell in love. 25 years later, Uri and Anna are still in love. But when the Mossad recruits Uri for a dangerous mission in Germany, memories start to return, cracks begin to appear in their perfect relationship, and a terrible suspicion grows in Anna.

name: 4 Elements: The Air
summary: Heir to the Madelin throne Princess Blue pays a visit to Thailand where she meets Wayo Wathinwanit, a police officer assigned to look after her safety. However, their trip turns into a nightmare when an assassination attempt forces the princess to flee, and Lom is the only one who can protect her. While hiding from the enemy, the two face danger and situations of defiance, leading them to an intimacy and forbidden feelings that may not be stopped. Though knowing well that this time, love may be impossible, Lom's heart demands that she protects the princess at all costs. When the enemy discover their hiding place, a final battle is about to take place.

name: Grave Conversations
summary: This promises viewers an unforgettable journey into the depths of human existence, while Dastmalchian guides his guests through discussions that delve into personal reflections on mortality, legacy, and the afterlife.

name: Die Festspiele der Reality Stars – Wer ist die hellste Kerze?
summary: Die Festspiele der Reality Stars - Wer ist die hellste Kerze? is a German game show in which various reality stars compete against each other to win the title of "Brightest Candle on the Cake". There were two episodes in the first season. The winner of the first episode competed in the second episode against the winner of the second episode in the final game. The second season consisted of three episodes. The winners of the first two episodes therefore competed against the winner of the third episode in the final game in the third episode.

name: The Alphabet Game
summary: A comedy word game in which five celebrity guests help two contestants.

name: Promi Big Brother – Die Late Night Show
summary: Promi Big Brother - Die Late Night Show is a live late-night show that has been broadcast on sixx from August 2014 to August 2020 and on Sat.1 since August 2021 as part of the Promi Big Brotherprogram. During the first season, the show ran under the title Promi Big Brother - Late Night Live.

name: Buchstaben Battle
summary: Buchstaben Battle is a German TV game show hosted by Ruth Moschner, following an international "Alphabet Games" format. The show focuses on wordplay, letters, and speed, with contestants competing in various challenges based on spelling and word construction.

name: Questions pour un champion
summary: Four contestants compete in 3 successive rounds of general knowledge questions. The lowest-performing contestant is eliminated at the end of each round, and the winner is the contestant who wins the last round, giving him/her the right to replay the next show.

name: William à midi !
summary: William à Midi ! was a French lifestyle magazine presented by William Leymergie.

name: Bonjour ! La Matinale TF1
summary: Bonjour ! La Matinale TF1 is a French television program broadcast live on TF1 Monday to Friday from 6:55 to 9:30 a.m. since January 8, 2024. The morning show features short news editions and various columns, and is presented by Bruce Toussaint.

name: Champs-Elysées
summary: Champs-Élysées was a French television variety show presented by Michel Drucker and broadcast live from January 9, 1982 to June 1985 and from January 1986 to June 29, 1990 every Saturday evening on Antenne 2, for around 300 episodes, and irregularly on France 2 from November 13, 2010 to May 11, 2013. The show owes its name to the fact that it is broadcast live from the Pavillon Gabriel, located on Avenue Gabriel along the Champs-Élysées in Paris.

name: Morning Live
summary: Morning Live was a French morning television show broadcast from July 3, 2000 to June 27, 2003 on M6.

name: Bonjour la France
summary: Bonjour la France then Bonjour la France, bonjour l'Europe was a morning magazine show created and presented by Jean-Claude Bourret alongside Muriel Hees (weather) every weekend morning from September 15, 1984, on TF1, modelled on Good Morning America, and from September 1987 with Jean Offredo, Jean-Claude Narcy, Ladislas de Hoyos or Michel Cardoze until December 30, 1990.

name: Velvet El Nuevo Imperio
summary: Talented designer Ana Velázquez arrives at Velvet and falls in love with Alberto Márquez, heir to the company, but their love must overcome many intrigues, including a marriage of convenience.

name: Born to Be Viral: The Real Lives of Kidfluencers
summary: Follows the extraordinary journey of the first generation of children whose entire upbringing has been shared online by their parents - often to millions of people, with some families earning millions of dollars.

name: Las hijas de la Señora García
summary:
Ofelia García is willing to do anything to get her family out of poverty. One of the ways to achieve this is by gaining fame through her youngest daughter, Mar, whom Ofelia takes to different auditions, teaching her that beauty is the key to success. In contrast, her eldest daughter, Valeria, believes in hard work, which leads to conflicts with her mother.

When the Portilla family, owners of a fortune, announces the search for a new face for their sports brand, Ofelia sees an opportunity to achieve her goal, regardless of who she has to push out of her way.

name: Легенды СССР
summary: The Soviet Union was one of the most powerful states in human history. Classified documents, fabricated evidence, scientific experiments and much more - there are still a huge number of secrets about that era.

name: Survival Mode
summary: Across nine episodes, the series chronicles some of the most recent devastating disasters - including the Maui wildfires, the Amtrak 501 derailment, Superstorm Sandy, and the sinking of the Costa Concordia - through firsthand accounts from survivors and rare archival footage.

name: Songs & Stories With Kelly Clarkson
summary: In this heartfelt four-part special, Kelly Clarkson gives viewers a front-row pass to unfiltered conversations and intimate musical collaborations with chart-topping artists Gloria Estefan, Jonas Brothers, Lizzo and Teddy Swims.

name: Escenas de Matrimonio
summary: Escenas de matrimonio is a comedy television series premiered on Telecinco in 2007 and produced by Alba Adriatica. It premiered on August 1, 2007 where it showed the reactions of couples living in the same building to similar situations they deal with in their daily lives. The series was cancelled due to its low audience on August 30, 2009. Afterwards a sequel was made called Escenas de matrimonio 2, but the audience continued not to respond, which caused it to be cancelled as well.

name: Stay by My Side after the Rain
summary: Kanade is an office worker who's unfulfilled in life...and keeps the fact that he's gay a secret. Everything changes when he reunites with an old classmate from high school: Mashiro, the boy Kanade secretly liked back in his youth. Mashiro's arrival seems to bring new sunlight to Kanade's dreary life. As they get to know each other again as adults, could this be Kanade's chance to find love with the one who got away?

name: The Last Captains
summary: Follows generational fishing families living in a remote archipelago in the Gulf of the St. Lawrence. While the fishermen chase big catches and paydays on the water, the 400 residents in town are in the fight of their lives to stave off Mother Nature and preserve their unique community.

name: Tschappel
summary: The Swabian term "chachappel" lovingly describes a "dye" or "depp", which stumbles naively and easily through life. This is how our hero Carlo Brenner, who comes from an Upper Swabian provincial village and is looking for himself, is also what he feels like.

previousepisode.name: Der Tag, als Carlo Brenner starb

name: 浅葱と広海～明日への扉～
summary: The letter he received contained a confession and a resolution from his partner. In a sudden sound, a memory, beyond the door—Hiromi was truly there. Was it an illusion, or lingering feelings left behind? As he faces the past, can his fingers once again continue the dream, playing it alone?

name: Папа Миа
summary: Nikolai Larionov, the author of one hit of the 2000s, dreams of regaining his former glory and does not suspect that, besides music, there is another pride in his life - his 14-year-old daughter Kosha. Everything changes when ex-wife Jeanne flies to Italy and asks to look after the teenager. Kosha is not happy about the appearance of her sloppy father and wants to get rid of him, while Nikolai is looking for a way to return triumphantly to show business. A common cause will help them in this — an online dating agency.

name: Love Thunder
summary: They meet, fall in love, and die across time—soulmates bound by fate, drawn together no matter how many times they're reborn. In a new life, they reunite once more. Can they escape the tragedy that keeps repeating? A love story of two people defying fate, where love and thunder collide.

name: Granskningskommisjonen
summary: Documentary about plane crashes - what happens after a plane crash?

name: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi
summary: Part of an all-new Star Wars: Visions Presents banner, which will be used to tell longer-form Star Wars: Visions stories, the limited series picks up not long after the events of the Visions shorts: "The Ninth Jedi" and "The Ninth Jedi: Child of Hope". In the new series, Lah Kara continues to train in the ways of the Jedi under Margrave Juro. Kara goes on an epic journey of self-discovery as she and Juro's small fellowship of Jedi-in-training embark on a quest to save her father.

name: Irmãos Coragem
summary: In the fictional city of Coroado, in the middle of Goiás, three brothers rebel against the power of the landowner Pedro Barros, who controls the diamond trade in the region.

name: Irmãos Coragem
summary: The soap opera features as its central characters João, Jerônimo and Duda, three brothers who threaten the dominance of the powerful farmer Pedro Barros, the highest authority in the fictional Coroado, in the interior of Minas Gerais, where the story is set.

name: Mondiali 2006 - Destino Azzurro
summary: The story of the Italian national team's unpredictable victory at the 2006 World Cup. Relive the memory of that great undertaking, told by the members of that unforgettable team.

name: Detective's Wife
summary: Adam Conway is a private detective in New York. His investigations are often complicated by the well-meaning interference of his wife, Connie, who has a knack for causing trouble.

previousepisode.name: The Case Of Percival The Prophet

name: Dream Destination: A Surprise Trip
summary: Poncho Herrera will take Karla Souza, Paulina Rubio, Melissa Joan Hart and Tony Dalton to Xcaret to surprise them with a dream reunion.

name: Dopamine
summary: Woo Gang, a gaming rookie, decides to follow his friends and visit a gay club for the first time. But in the club bathroom, his friends tease him by saying: "People actually do it in the bathroom here." "Can I give it a try?" Thinking it's all a joke, Woo Gang stumbles upon the unexpected. As he processes what he's seen, someone approaches him...

name: I'd Rather Quit Than Die, Director!
summary: Jinwoo Seo, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Eui-hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead!

name: Ippon! : Hold Me Tight
summary: A man who dreamed of becoming a national judo representative, Jun-woo, is defeated in a single match by Min-jae, who appeared like a comet.

name: No Dating at Boarding School
summary: Set in a strict boarding school, the coming-of-age romance follows students searching for love and identity.

name: Don't Confess Next to a Corpse
summary: Late at night, Gunha and Gwangmin are left alone, bickering over an assignment, and end up dozing off. When they wake up, there's a dead body lying next to them! An assignment, a body, and a confession—how much more can they handle in one night?
